image_description: A medium shot of a youth orchestra or band rehearsal. In the foreground, two young men are playing bassoons. The subject on the right is in sharper focus, holding a dark reddish-brown wooden bassoon with silver keys and a curved metal bocal. To his left, another student plays a similar instrument, partially obscured. A third student in a white shirt is visible in the background between them. The background features a grey acoustic wall panel.

The main body segments are clearly constructed from turned wood, joined together, distinct from the metal bocal and keys.
